outcome: One discovery seam serves every entry point: a shared resolver over the project's .sworn surface (runs, manifests, releases on release-wt refs, drivers.json, operator.json by convention) powers bare sworn run, sworn run with a release name under the three-step precedence, and the flagless surfaces that follow - so knowing absolute paths stops being the price of admission.

exclude: engine behaviour (the resolver finds and names; it never starts, approves, or mutates anything)
changing the explicit-flag forms (they remain and stay authoritative when given)
cross-project or fleet discovery (single project root only)

acceptance.text: Bare sworn run in a project with exactly one resumable run resumes it, and with exactly one recorded-and-approved release and no journal starts it; ambiguity refuses with the candidates named: pinned by cmd/sworn unit fixtures over a fixture project tree.

sworn run with a release name resolves manifest, journal, and driver config from the project surface under the documented precedence (explicit flag beats project file beats refusal-with-names): pinned by a precedence table fixture in cmd/sworn.

The TUI's private discovery is the same seam: cmd/sworn/tui_project.go's resolution routes through the shared resolver with no behaviour change, pinned by the existing TUI project fixtures passing unmodified or with mechanical renames only.

The resolver locates .sworn/operator.json by convention and surfaces it to callers, without requiring it: pinned by resolver fixtures covering present, absent, and unreadable cases with named refusals.

constraints: Explicit flags always win; discovery only fills absence, never overrides.
A refusal names what was searched and what was found (the #169/#177 lesson: an empty answer must say where it looked).
Evidence basis: sworn run requires two absolute paths today (cmd/sworn/main.go:241 hard-requires --manifest --journal); discovery exists but is TUI-private (cmd/sworn/tui_project.go).
The e2e check is declared, not executed by a role (ADR 0010).
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
